title: Scalar mate of exact restriction and geometric pullback
statement: For a morphism a:R→T of commutative condensed rings and a scheme map f:X→S, use the exact restriction/pullback comparison CondensedRing.derivedComapUpperStarIso and the canonical identifications of exact inverse image with its left derived functor. This gives scalarRestrictionPullbackIso: Lf*_T followed by derived restriction at X is isomorphic to derived restriction at S followed by Lf*_R. Its scalar adjunction mate scalarPullbackComparison is a natural transformation Lf*_R followed by derived scalar extension at X → derived scalar extension at S followed by Lf*_T. No flatness or invertibility assertion is included. The derived coefficient and geometric functors are those of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints] and [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-exchange]. ScalarPullbackEndpointSquare is the proposition that its component on a shifted degree-zero R-module, followed by geometric pullback of a scalar endpoint and the T-pullback endpoint, equals scalar extension of the R-pullback endpoint followed by the scalar endpoint on X. Its single field is this equation; the endpoint data are those of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback-endpoints].
